text: Discipline positioningNew Energy Science and Engineering belongs to the field of engineering and is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates energy engineering, materials science, chemistry, physics, control technology, etc. It focuses on the development, conversion, storage and application of non-fossil energy sources such as solar energy, wind energy, hydrogen energy, biomass energy, geothermal energy and nuclear energy, aiming to solve problems such as energy shortage, environmental pollution and sustainable development.Development backgroundUnder the impetus of the global "dual carbon" goals (carbon peak and carbon neutrality), the transformation of traditional fossil energy is accelerating. New energy technologies (such as photovoltaic, wind power, and energy storage) have become strategic emerging industries of the country. Relying on policies such as the "14th Five-Year Plan" for energy and the Renewable Energy Law, they are developing rapidly.
